title: Graph becomes a repo-resident artifact
summary: Decision: the shared graph layer (edges, notes, summaries, knowledge, terminal-status snapshots) moves from ~/.claude/orchestrator/overlay/ into a committed directory in the target repo, so git is the team sync layer. Plain in-repo dir, NOT a submodule (pointer-bump churn). Machine-local runtime state (assignee, worktrees, cancel/stop flags, judge cursors) stays in the home dir. Representation under discussion: leaning append-only event log (JSONL, merge=union) with CRDT-compatible semantics so a Yjs/WebRTC live layer can be added later without changing the artifact. Prerequisites: shared/local split of overlay schema; workspace keyed by repo identity instead of absolute-path hash.
